_about: Component spec for pos-tooltip (style/pos-tooltip.css). Built 2026-09-04 as a small attribute-driven utility (data-tooltip="text" directly on an icon-only control, no wrapper markup) to satisfy RULES.md 4.2's mandatory icon-only-control-needs-a-tooltip rule, then given a full standalone Variants/Usage/Tokens doc entry 2026-09-08. Single representative variant (no Variant toggle — there is only one visual form). States are Normal (tooltip not shown — the target element looks completely unaffected, so this state has zero applicable tokens, same pattern as Popover's Closed state) and Visible (shown on real :hover/:focus-visible, or simulated here via .pos-debug-tooltip-visible for the static preview toggle). Colors were corrected from the very first build (which used the then-unused --pos-color-standout-background/-text pair): background is --pos-color-content-icon (the plain default icon token — dark grey light, light grey dark, white HC) and text is --pos-color-content-inverted-text (white light, black dark/HC), not the standout tokens. font-family/font-weight added 2026-09-08 to match this rulebook's Typography-pairing rule (7.2) and for consistency with Chip/Tag's own floating-label treatment (same --pos-font-badge family) — the very first build only set font-size, leaving the family to silently inherit from the page default. 2026-10-06: second type icon-text added (in sync with the Figma Tooltip's Type property: text / icon-text) — .pos-tooltip-anchor + .pos-tooltip (role=tooltip, aria-describedby), icon + one or two lines, non-interactive (no link). Docs controls: Type (Text / Icon-text, = the variants) and State (Hidden / Visible). 2026-10-06: bottom padding 4px like the top (Figma had 8px).
name: Tooltip
description: A small contextual label that appears above an element on hover or keyboard focus, without requiring a click or taking up permanent layout space.
whenToUse: Icon-only controls — every icon-only button/action always needs one (RULES.md 4.2), reusing its own aria-label text.
A short, supplementary hint that clarifies an already-visible control's purpose (e.g. confirming what a "+" button adds).
Icon-text type: a hint that needs a little more than a label — an icon and one or two short lines (the second bold).
whenNotToUse: Content the user must be able to select, copy, or interact with — a tooltip disappears on blur/mouseout and cannot hold focus.
Essential information with no other way to discover it — a tooltip is a supplement, never the only source of an instruction.
Touch-only interfaces with no hover/focus-visible equivalent — provide a visible label or a tap-triggered alternative instead.
do: Always set the exact same text in both aria-label and data-tooltip on the target element — the tooltip is a visual echo of the accessible name, not separate content.
Keep the text to a few words — the bubble does not wrap (white-space: nowrap).
Icon-text type: wrap the control in .pos-tooltip-anchor, put the .pos-tooltip bubble right after it with role="tooltip" and an id, and point the control's aria-describedby at that id.
dont: Put interactive content (links, buttons) inside a tooltip — it disappears the moment focus/hover moves toward it.
Use a tooltip as the only label for a control that also needs a real aria-label — always pair the two.
Use the icon-text type for a long explanation or a link — use a popover instead.
accessibility: Shown on both :hover AND :focus-visible, so keyboard users see the same information mouse users do.

Purely visual/supplementary — screen readers announce the element's own aria-label, not the tooltip bubble (attr(data-tooltip) content is not exposed to the accessibility tree), so the two must always carry the same text.
pointer-events: none on the bubble itself — it can never trap focus or intercept a click meant for the element underneath it.

Icon-text type: the bubble is real text (role="tooltip") announced as the control's description through aria-describedby; the icon is decorative. It shows on hover and while focus is inside the anchor.

props.name: data-tooltip
props.description: The tooltip's visible text — set it on the interactive element itself, no wrapper needed. Always mirror the element's aria-label.

props.name: .pos-tooltip-anchor
props.description: Wraps the control and the bubble; the bubble shows on its hover and while focus is inside it.

props.name: role="tooltip" + id
props.description: The bubble is real text; give it role="tooltip" and an id.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Points at the bubble's id, so screen readers announce it as the control's description.

tokens.role: Bubble padding (half this value vertically, full value horizontally) and the gap between the bubble and its target element
Icon–text gap, gap above the control
Pull between the two text lines
